role: Independent measurement and fresh routing rating

before.method: Signed-ring area from actual captured BREP pours. Same-net via/PTH drills are not separately subtracted. Per-net pour objects sum and may overlap.

after.method: Signed-ring area from actual captured BREP pours. Same-net via/PTH drills are not separately subtracted. Per-net pour objects sum and may overlap.

collateralRoutingCost.interpretation: The local OUT-cap placement requires a longer protected permission-supply feed. Overall and changed-scope totals include this cost.

methodLimits: Planar sums count overlapping same-net objects separately; no vertical barrel length or extracted parasitics.
45-degree bound omits obstacles, electrical isolation and return-path constraints; it does not prove a safe reroute.
Placement moves and removal of efficient short branches change the detour-ratio denominator. A higher aggregate ratio can coexist with shorter critical paths; it is not a routing-score formula.
Changed identities use source names, with endpoint display for unnamed copper. Added/removed names require semantic pairing.
Priority metrics sum listed concrete routes and flag missing names; they are not a Dijkstra analysis of wide copper.
No DRC, net continuity, width/fabrication compliance, or manufacturing acceptance claim follows from these economy metrics.
